_note: v3.0 43 T live check, no backend: SillyTavern's own lorebook editor saves a whole book from the copy it drew (world-info.js:4151). A book is opened in ST's editor, another write changes entry 1 on the server, then the editor's own input handler edits entry 0 and its debounced save runs. Control (#so-wi-editor-merge off): ST's save overwrites the other write. Fix (on): the save goes through the lore plugin's conditional commit, 409, three-way merge, both changes kept, ST's cache refreshed with the merged book. Run: node scripts/debug/st-lanes.mts run <no-model lane> -- scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v30-43t-lore-editor-merge.json --sandbox --group "Group: Arin, DM Narrator".

requires.why: ST's lorebook editor in a real page; no model call

steps.eval: const g = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings(); if (g.image?.enabled !== false || g.sprites?.enabled !== false) throw new Error('images or sprites are on'); const status = await fetch('/api/plugins/story-orchestrator-lore/status', { headers: SillyTavern.getContext().getRequestHeaders() }); return { lorePlugin: status.ok, editorMerge: g.worldInfo.editorMerge };

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); if (!document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open]')) document.querySelector('#so-drawer .drawer-toggle')?.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#so-workspace-context-orchestrator'); i += 1) await wait(150); document.querySelector('#so-workspace-context-orchestrator')?.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#so-workspace-page-world'); i += 1) await wait(150); document.querySelector('#so-workspace-page-world')?.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#so-wi-editor-merge'); i += 1) await wait(150); if (!document.querySelector('#so-wi-editor-merge')) throw new Error('#so-wi-editor-merge not rendered'); return { editorMerge: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().worldInfo.editorMerge };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); for (let i = 0; i < 20 && rt.getGlobalSettings().worldInfo.editorMerge !== false; i += 1) await wait(150); if (rt.getGlobalSettings().worldInfo.editorMerge !== false) throw new Error('editorMerge did not land'); document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open]')?.close(); await wait(400); return { editorMerge: false };

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const wi = await import('/scripts/world-info.js'); const name = 'SO-T Guard Control'; const entry = (uid, comment, content) => ({ uid, comment, content, key: [comment.toLowerCase()], keysecondary: [], disable: false, position: 0, order: 100, depth: 4 }); const made = await fetch('/api/worldinfo/edit', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name, data: { entries: { 0: entry(0, 'Harbor ' + name, 'The harbor is quiet.'), 1: entry(1, 'Keeper', 'The keeper sleeps.') } } }) }); if (!made.ok) throw new Error('book create failed ' + made.status); await wi.updateWorldInfoList(); const idx = wi.world_names.indexOf(name); if (idx < 0) throw new Error('book not listed'); if (!document.querySelector('#WIDrawerIcon.openIcon')) document.querySelector('#WIDrawerIcon')?.click(); await wait(500); $('#world_editor_select').val(idx).trigger('change'); const shown = () => document.querySelector('#world_popup_entries_list .world_entry[uid="0"] textarea[name="comment"]')?.value === 'Harbor ' + name; for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !shown(); i += 1) await wait(150); if (!shown()) throw new Error('the editor did not switch to ' + name); document.querySelector('#world_popup_entries_list .world_entry[uid="0"] .inline-drawer-toggle')?.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#world_popup_entries_list .world_entry[uid="0"] textarea[name="content"]'); i += 1) await wait(150); const area = document.querySelector('#world_popup_entries_list .world_entry[uid="0"] textarea[name="content"]'); if (!area) throw new Error('editor did not draw entry 0'); return { book: name, editorShows: area.value, editorMerge: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().worldInfo.editorMerge };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const name = 'SO-T Guard Control'; const server = await (await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name }), cache: 'no-cache' })).json(); server.entries[1].content = 'The keeper woke when the story met him.'; const wrote = await fetch('/api/worldinfo/edit', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name, data: server }) }); if (!wrote.ok) throw new Error('story-side write failed'); const after = await (await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name }), cache: 'no-cache' })).json(); return { stage: 'a write landed on the server while the editor shows the old book', server1: after.entries[1].content };

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const wi = await import('/scripts/world-info.js'); const name = 'SO-T Guard Control'; const area = document.querySelector('#world_popup_entries_list .world_entry[uid="0"] textarea[name="content"]'); area.value = 'The harbor fills with boats.'; area.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await wait(4500); const server = await (await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name }), cache: 'no-cache' })).json(); const cached = wi.worldInfoCache.has(name) ? wi.worldInfoCache.get(name) : null; const out = { arm: 'control: editorMerge off', server0: server.entries[0]?.content, server1: server.entries[1]?.content, cache1: cached?.entries?.[1]?.content ?? null, entries: Object.keys(server.entries) }; if (out.server0 !== 'The harbor fills with boats.') throw new Error('the editor edit did not save: ' + JSON.stringify(out)); if (out.server1 !== 'The keeper sleeps.') throw new Error('control expected ST to overwrite the story write: ' + JSON.stringify(out)); return out;

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); if (!document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open]')) document.querySelector('#so-drawer .drawer-toggle')?.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#so-workspace-context-orchestrator'); i += 1) await wait(150); document.querySelector('#so-workspace-context-orchestrator')?.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#so-workspace-page-world'); i += 1) await wait(150); document.querySelector('#so-workspace-page-world')?.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#so-wi-editor-merge'); i += 1) await wait(150); if (!document.querySelector('#so-wi-editor-merge')) throw new Error('#so-wi-editor-merge not rendered'); return { editorMerge: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().worldInfo.editorMerge };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); for (let i = 0; i < 20 && rt.getGlobalSettings().worldInfo.editorMerge !== true; i += 1) await wait(150); if (rt.getGlobalSettings().worldInfo.editorMerge !== true) throw new Error('editorMerge did not land'); document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open]')?.close(); await wait(400); return { editorMerge: true };

const wi = await import('/scripts/world-info.js'); const out = {}; for (const name of ['SO-T Guard Control','SO-T Guard Fix']) { if (wi.world_names.includes(name)) out[name] = await wi.deleteWorldInfo(name); } if (document.querySelector('#WIDrawerIcon.openIcon')) document.querySelector('#WIDrawerIcon')?.click(); return out;
